messages.content: Write a polished short scene in modern American English between two adult friends who are waiting for an uncertain answer. Keep the tension low and realistic. Nothing dangerous happens. Let anticipation show through small behaviors and changes in conversation without using suspense clichés or ominous language.

Jordan checked her phone again.

Alex looked up from the magazine. “Still nothing?”

“Nope.”

“You've checked six times.”

“Seven.”

Alex smiled. “That's better.”

Jordan put the phone facedown.

Two seconds later, she picked it up again.

“You're terrible at waiting.”

“I know.”

“Want something to eat?”

“Maybe.”

“That's not an answer.”

“Neither is maybe.”

Alex closed the magazine. “Pretzels?”

Jordan nodded.

They sat quietly for a minute.

The phone stayed facedown on the table.

Jordan reached toward it, then stopped.

Alex noticed.

“You can check.”

“I don't want to.”

“Okay.”

A few seconds passed.

Jordan smiled. “This is ridiculous.”

“A little.”

She picked up the phone.

Alex laughed. “There it is.”
